text: The purpose of this report is to propose meeting schedules for the Toronto Zoo Board of Management and its Committees for 2020.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo approved the following meeting dates for the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo and its Committees for 2020: 1. Board of Management: a. Thursday, February 6, 2020 at 9:30 a.m. at the Toronto Zoo; b. Tuesday, March 24, 2020 at 2:00 p.m. at the Toronto Zoo; c. Wednesday, June 17, 2020 at 2:00 p.m. at the Toronto Zoo; d. Thursday, August 13, 2020 at 2:00 p.m. at City Hall; e. Thursday, October 8, 2020 at 2:00 pm. at the Toronto Zoo; and f. Tuesday, December 1, 2020 at 2:00 p.m. at City Hall. 2. Policy and Finance Committee: a. Thursday, May 14, 2020 at 10:00 a.m. at the Toronto Zoo; b. Thursday, August 27, 2020 at 10:00 a.m. at the Toronto Zoo; and c.
